rationale: View::request_repaint(Rect) maps a bounded repaint through the view's transform and scroll instead of escalating to the whole surface; WindowHost and PluginViewHost gain request_frame() (a frame with no damage); no-op paint setters do not count as unmarked changes; Knob, Fader, RangeSlider and XYPad gain display-only modulated indicators. Additive API only (new virtual appended, base no-op), paint is clipped to the requested extents so output is pixel-identical, covered by bounded-repaint and parameter-binding tests with confirmed negative controls. No authority boundary moves; Pulp-only repaint and display behaviour.
